title: Days Away After a Released Bed or an Ended Private Hold — Reconciled Estimate Months
content:
For Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage, a reconciled estimate month loses, as days with no cost, the days the resident was away after a held bed was given up — a reservation under Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations that was released, or a private hold that ended unpaid or at its maximum.

**Clause.** Days of a reconciled estimate month away after a held bed was given up: where the resident's latest reservation in status released, by release date, and the resident's latest private hold that ended unpaid or at its maximum, by end date, both fall in part inside the month, the days after the release up to the day before that reservation's return and the days after that private hold's last held day up to the day before its return are both taken out; where only that released reservation does, the days after the release up to the day before its return (to the month's end where the resident has not come back); where only that private hold does, the days after its last held day up to the day before its return; otherwise none. Where a hold that ended unpaid and one that ended at its maximum share the latest end date, the one that ended unpaid is read. Where the resident has not come back, a span runs to the month's end; where two records otherwise share the latest date, the one posted first is read.

**Cases (hypothetical, 31-day month).**

1. Released reservation, released on day 6, return on day 15; no private hold ended in a way that reaches the month: days 7 to 14, 8 days, are taken out.
2. No released reservation reaching the month; the latest private hold ended at its maximum with last held day on day 24 and return on day 28: days 25 to 27, 3 days, are taken out.
3. Both of the above in the same month: 11 days are taken out.
4. A released reservation and a private hold whose spans both lie wholly in earlier months: no day is taken out.
